title: Indenture English Penman Font
author: Intellecta Design
description:
Indenture English Penman is based on research into original English and American indenture contracts from the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries, mostly with roundhand scripts, paragraph versals in Old English script and many, many flourishes, plus an approach to the works of George Bickham, the great calligrapher.
This font has a little of everything, with hundreds of glyphs (over 800 indeed) : dozens of versals to each alphabet letter, some versals in Old English style, plus flourishes to use at beginnings of paragraphs or chapters, and many additional flourishes to create perfect ancient documents.
To better use the resources of this font we suggest using the Glyphs resource in Illustrator and other software.

title: Enchanted Land DS Font Font
author: Sharkshock
description: The second installment of the Enchanted Land family takes you on another medieval adventure, opting to completely rebuild instead of refining the legacy script. More emphasis was put on the undulating nature of the uppercase characters and how they keep your eyes flowing. For this reason, straight lines and right angles are rarely used in favor of flamboyant terminals and wispy swashes. Lowercase characters, by contrast, adhere to a consistent model defined by its straightened edges and sharp corners. This script flirts with several old-world styles but seeks only to borrow elements rather than completely emulate them. German Blackletter, Old English, Uncial, Victorian, it’s in there! Enchanted Land DS would work well in a book, video game, or medieval signage.

title: Deertail Brush Font
author: Alit Design
description:
Deertail Brush Typeface: A Retro-Inspired Dynamic Font
Step back into the golden age of hand-painted signs and vintage posters with the Deertail Brush Typeface. This typeface captures the rugged charm of paintbrush strokes and the energetic flow of dynamic handwriting, making it perfect for projects that seek an authentic vintage aesthetic. Whether you’re designing for branding, packaging, posters, or social media, Deertail Brush adds a punchy, nostalgic feel that stands out.
Font Highlights:
1. 792 Character Glyphs Deertail Brush offers an extensive library of 792 glyphs, ensuring that your designs never feel repetitive. This expansive range includes uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, punctuation, and special symbols, allowing you to explore creative text arrangements with endless possibilities.
2. Rich Alternatives & Ligatures For those seeking variety, Deertail Brush is packed with alternative characters and ligatures. This feature enables you to create a more organic, hand-lettered look by swapping out default characters for stylistic alternatives and connecting letter combinations with ligatures. Perfect for achieving that flowing brushstroke effect in headlines, logos, and large-scale text.
3. Multilingual Support Going global? Deertail Brush supports multiple languages, including Western and Central European characters, so you can effortlessly extend your designs to different regions. From English to Spanish, French, German, and more, the font provides all the necessary accents and symbols to create localized content.
4. PUA Unicode Accessibility Deertail Brush is PUA encoded, which means every alternate character and special glyph is fully accessible without professional design software. You can easily browse and use all the font’s hidden characters in any software that supports fonts, like Photoshop, Illustrator, or even basic text editors.
5. Vintage Dingbat Bonuses Take your designs a step further with the included dingbat bonuses—a collection of hand-drawn icons and illustrations that complement the font’s vintage aesthetic. Use these elements to enhance your typography, create unique embellishments, or build complete compositions with a retro flair.
Where to Use Deertail Brush Typeface?
Deertail Brush is versatile and adaptable, making it a fantastic choice for:
Vintage Signage: Create authentic retro signage or chalkboard-style menus.
Posters & Flyers: Design bold, dynamic posters that demand attention with lively brushstroke text.
Branding & Logos: Give your brand a distinctive, hand-crafted feel with stylish typography that stands out from the crowd.
Merchandise & Packaging: Perfect for vintage-themed product packaging or apparel designs that want to capture a nostalgic feel.
Social Media Graphics: Craft bold and energetic social media visuals that evoke the charm of vintage advertising.
T-shirts & Apparel: Let your typography shine on printed goods, with a classic yet vibrant personality.
Why Choose Deertail Brush?
Deertail Brush combines the ruggedness of traditional brush fonts with modern versatility, making it a must-have for designers looking to capture the authenticity of vintage sign art. Its extensive character set, multilingual support, and alternative glyphs make it easy to customize every word. Plus, with PUA Unicode and fun dingbat bonuses, you can elevate your projects with ease and creativity.
Bring a sense of history, craft, and dynamism to your designs with the Deertail Brush Typeface – a font that leaves a lasting impression!
Get ready to craft your next masterpiece with Deertail Brush – where vintage inspiration meets modern design needs.

description: Introducing Letinegra: a modern blackletter font. Inspired from old English era, this font suits best for design that need a bold, classic, and striking feels such as headline, poster design, logotype, apparel design etc. Available in two styles; Regular and Italic, also in multilingual characters.

title: Berpatu Font
author: majestype
description: Berpatu is a brush lettering font inspired by the signature retro and vintage designs that can be found in shop windows and billboards on the street. Made with passion using a brush pen. This font brings a unique, retro, and vintage feel to your designs.
